technology_name: A THERMAL MANAGEMENT SYSTEM FOR LITHIUM-ION BATTERY MODULES BASED ON VARIABLE THERMAL CONDUCTIVITY
institution: National Institute of Technology Calicut (NIT Calicut)
technology_type: Battery Pack Enclosure Hardware / Thermal Management
problem_solved: Lithium-ion battery packs endure extreme thermal gradients during fast charging, creating high thermal degradation risks and reducing performance consistency across adjacent internal cells.
description: A specialized battery thermal containment assembly featuring an multi-chamber housing where individual lithium-ion cells are organized in strict matrix arrays flanked by inserts of shifting thickness values and varying long-range thermal conductivity coefficients.
applications: Electric vehicle battery enclosure manufacturing, stationary grid energy storage arrays, aerospace high-capacity battery vaults, and industrial power packs.
secondary_sector: Advanced Materials & Chemical, Infrastructure, Construction & Smart Cities
